# Selectors CI passes to one `holbuild check` after the build: each must stay
# free of cheats, oracles, axioms and hypotheses. THEORY checks every stored
# theorem of a theory; THEORY:THEOREM checks one. Add a selector here to
# enforce a theorem or theory clean; never check tags or hypotheses in a script.
